'''''A New Hope''''' was a painting depicting [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] head, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]], and some [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. It was made to commemorate the thirtieth anniversary of something called ''[[Star Wars]]''.

The painting included some text in the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]], including ''Star Wars''&mdash;the title of what was being commemorated&mdash;and a tagline: "A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away..." The meaning of this tagline is dubious, since everything depicted existed in the [[The galaxy/Legends|same galaxy]] as the painting itself.
There was also a list of ambiguous names, possibly entertainers within the saga being noted, written in the High Galactic alphabet.

==Behind the scenes==
This painting was only given out to players of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' who logged on during the 30th anniversary celebration of ''[[Star Wars]]''. Unlike the other items specific to this celebration, which had to be acquired from [[Wikipedia:non-player characters|Non-Player Characters]] (NPC's), ''A New Hope'' was placed immediately in the player's inventory.

This painting is actually the theatrical poster for [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], a [[1977]] movie made by [[George Lucas]], and the first film in the ''Star Wars'' saga.
